title: eludite.file.open input
description: Open a file in an editor tab, or activate its tab if it is open (double-click in Workspace, a click on an Error List row). Optionally move the caret to a 1-based line and column and scroll it into view. A `.resx` file opens as its resource set's grid (the .resx editor, proposal 0005) unless `editor` is `text` or the setting `resx.openAsText` is on; the tab is then `resx:<neutral file>`.

path.description: Absolute path of the file, or a path relative to the open solution's directory.

line.description: 1-based line to put the caret on.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) to put the caret on; 1 when omitted.

editor.description: `default`: the editor the file's kind has (the .resx editor for a `.resx`); `text`: the text editor (Open With > XML (Text) Editor in the Workspace window).
